name: once
algorithm: t workers (Mk: tasks; Go: goroutines; Rust: OS threads) share one lazily initialized value; each does n rounds of getting it (the first get runs an init that returns 7) and adds it. Prints 7 * t * n (README.md). Measures the get of a value that exists: one load and a branch on every side.

skip.c: C11 call_once runs a function once but holds no value; the row compares a lazily initialized value
skip.zig: no once primitive in Zig 0.17's std

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the sum shows every get returned the value
notes: Written by std-sync2 (status/std-sync2.md, M6 session 1); checksums from the workload's arithmetic. Session 2 raised n from 2*10^7 to 10^9 so that every column runs for most of a second: at 2*10^7 the Rust column ran 13 ms.
